aboutMe.header: Solving complex tasks in a user-friendly application

aboutMe.descriptionFirst: Web developer with <accent>5+ years</accent> of experience in <accent>high-load applications</accent> and <accent>distributed systems</accent>.
aboutMe.descriptionSecond: I take on complex products: <accent>performance profiling</accent>, <accent>architecture</accent>, and <accent>unit and E2E tests</accent> — with attention to <accent>detail</accent> and <accent>accessibility (a11y)</accent>.

resume.description: From a Computer Science degree to production-grade products — I build <accent>full-stack applications</accent> with <accent>React, Next.js and Node.js</accent>, from <accent>real-time video (WebRTC)</accent> to <accent>AI agents</accent>. Below is a snapshot of my <accent>education</accent>, <accent>work experience</accent> and the <accent>tools</accent> I reach for every day.

educationTable.MAIDescription: Academic foundation under the applied work: programming in C, C++, Python and JS, databases, information security, artificial intelligence and higher mathematics.
educationTable.MAISubDescription: Built models on real datasets: regression, classification and clustering.
educationTable.HexletDescription: Built the JavaScript engineering foundation: OOP and abstraction through data, asynchronous programming, network protocols, TypeScript. Wrote tests and semantic markup, submitting every task through code review.
educationTable.YandexPracticumDescription: Covered the full frontend cycle: built several SPAs on React, Redux Toolkit and client-side routing — from markup and animations to secure auth, WebSocket and deployment. Configured Webpack builds and linters; every project passed mentor code review.

workExperience.proofixBullet1: Real-time video conferencing platform, owned end-to-end from FE↔BE contract to production observability.
workExperience.proofixBullet2: Cut monthly server costs 27% with a 1 room = 1 server architecture that eliminated idle resource allocation.
workExperience.proofixBullet3: Improved React rendering 1.4× by profiling the component tree and removing unnecessary re-renders.
workExperience.proofixBullet4: Raised test coverage from 0 to 87% with Playwright and React Testing Library on an untested codebase.
workExperience.proofixBullet5: Shipped AI interview agents (voice + text) and a facial-expression-analysis agent end-to-end, plus Document Picture-in-Picture.
workExperience.proofixBullet6: Architected real-time features on WebSocket, WebRTC and LiveKit, with observability via ElasticSearch and DataDog.
workExperience.everypixelBullet1: AI-native creative platform for video and image generation, leading the frontend architecture end-to-end.
workExperience.everypixelBullet2: Aggregated 10+ third-party AI models (Kling, Runway, Veo, Wan, Seedance) into a single editing workflow with real-time progress.
workExperience.everypixelBullet3: Owned the FE↔BE contract — REST schemas and WebSocket protocols — removing ad-hoc endpoints.
workExperience.everypixelBullet4: Built a virtualized media library with @tanstack/react-virtual for thousands of assets without layout thrashing.
workExperience.everypixelBullet5: Delivered race-condition-free uploads with react-dropzone and async-mutex and an accessible (WAI-ARIA) design system on Radix UI.
workExperience.everypixelBullet6: Integrated Sentry across the React Router 7 app and enforced consistency via an ESLint / Prettier / Stylelint / Husky pipeline.
workExperience.divergentBullet1: Product engineering and outsourcing, delivering 3 internal products from zero to production for hundreds of users.
workExperience.divergentBullet2: Replaced a manual report-creation process with a drag-and-drop document/report constructor built on React DnD.
workExperience.divergentBullet3: Reduced support response times with a real-time chat featuring presence indicators and message history.
workExperience.divergentBullet4: Eliminated runtime validation bugs by enforcing React Hook Form + Zod schemas across all forms.
workExperience.divergentBullet5: Standardized development environments with Docker, removing works-on-my-machine issues across the team.
